branches.fallbackBehavior: Verified composite source multiplies its serial base feeds and divides its serial quote feeds; second-feed slots are zero, and no alternative price source or freshness rejection exists in the composite. ChainlinkDataFeedLib explicitly leaves staleness checks to upstream feeds. This is not independent RedStone/Chainlink failover. Feed proxies implement upgradeable TransparentUpgradeableProxy; shared adapter and admin identities are pinned, but feed/adapter implementation source correspondence and any upstream fallback/freshness enforcement remain unverified.

collateralParameters.note: Liquidation LLTV from pinned idToMarketParams, not a legal collateral-recovery guarantee.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Morpho protocol liquidation permits third parties to repay unhealthy debt for collateral when oracle-valued LTV exceeds LLTV; exact collateral realization capacity is unverified.
branches.backstop: No exact-vault funded loss backstop was identified in the reviewed vault source and protocol documentation.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Underlying bad debt reduces reported adapter realAssets; VaultV2 recognizes losses through pro-rata share-value depreciation. No legal recovery waterfall is established.
